## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/chart`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ChartComponent`](/api/chart/ChartComponent) | Component | Root visualization container coordinating coordinate layouts, canvas rendering, theme styles, and interactions. |
| [`ChartXAxisComponent`](/api/chart/ChartXAxisComponent) | Component | Configures an X axis in Cartesian charts. |
| [`ChartYAxisComponent`](/api/chart/ChartYAxisComponent) | Component | Configures a Y axis in Cartesian charts. |
| [`ChartAnnotationComponent`](/api/chart/ChartAnnotationComponent) | Component | Renders callouts, milestone badges, and outlier markers anchored to specific (X, Y) coordinates. |
| [`ChartCrosshairComponent`](/api/chart/ChartCrosshairComponent) | Component | Renders dynamic crosshair guide lines and axis label badges for pointer and keyboard navigation in Cartesian XY charts. |
| [`ChartReferenceBandComponent`](/api/chart/ChartReferenceBandComponent) | Component | Renders highlighted threshold intervals and target regions in Cartesian XY charts. |
| [`ChartBrushComponent`](/api/chart/ChartBrushComponent) | Component | Selects a region of a Cartesian plot by dragging, or from the keyboard with `Shift` + arrows from a focused point. |
| [`ChartReferenceLineComponent`](/api/chart/ChartReferenceLineComponent) | Component | Renders static horizontal or vertical benchmark lines in Cartesian XY charts. |
| [`ChartSelectionComponent`](/api/chart/ChartSelectionComponent) | Component | Lets users select marks with the pointer and keyboard, and holds the selected mark IDs. |
| [`ChartLegendComponent`](/api/chart/ChartLegendComponent) | Component | Adds a legend. |
| [`ChartTooltipComponent`](/api/chart/ChartTooltipComponent) | Component | Adds a tooltip for pointer and keyboard interaction. |

| [`chartItemCategoryId`](/api/chart/chartItemCategoryId) | Function | The ID of the item whose category is `category`, as a radial bar or rose series gives an item without a `keyField` value. |
| [`chartItemIndexId`](/api/chart/chartItemIndexId) | Function | The ID of the item in row `index`, as a funnel stage, waterfall step, or radial bar or rose item gets it when it has no `keyField` value (and, for a radial series, no category). |
| [`chartItemKeyId`](/api/chart/chartItemKeyId) | Function | The ID of the item whose `keyField` value is `key`, as funnel stages, treemap nodes, waterfall steps and radial bar and rose items use it. |
